owner_task_reference: ChatGPT GPoint, user instruction 'Исправь это' followed by 'Делай' on 2026-11-23
task: Restore the absent production GPoint Telegram Bot so /start responds and refreshes the current Mini App launch button. Use existing GitHub Actions protected Deploy and pinned stock Kamal. Bootstrap only gpoint-core-bot from the verified already-installed Core image, preserving API/Worker/MiniApp/Eros.
acceptance_criteria: A single exact main-push admission; no subsequent pushes can retrigger Bot bootstrap.
No Bot start before exact live Core/MiniApp/Eros identities and Telegram credentials/webhook/host process checks pass.
Bot uses the immutable already-installed Core image and installed version, with no other role restarted.
Kamal verifies one Bot, same Core SHA/image; /health/ready returns ready after Telegram polling starts.
Normal Runtime Verify still proves Core, Mini App and Eros unchanged; real user /start and original old WebApp button require subsequent mobile smoke.
exclusions: restarting or redeploying Core API, Core Worker, Mini App or Eros
new release controller, manually dispatched duplicate, repeated blind retry

release_infrastructure.risk_description: Enabling an absent Telegram Bot can create competing polling consumers or use stale production credentials. The one-shot operation must stop without mutation when its approved live baseline, Telegram API identity/webhook or local process checks fail.
required_gates: live Core and MiniApp and Eros version/digest readback
exact immutable live Core image for Bot
GPoint bot token and username identity
release_infrastructure.backup_plan: No database or persistent volume mutation. Retain existing PostgreSQL/Redis backups and immutable Core/MiniApp/Eros images; do not alter production env values.
release_infrastructure.rollback_plan: If Bot readiness or post-deploy verification fails after creation, mark recovery required and inspect exact live state; only stop the newly created Bot through a separate verified owner-authorized stock Kamal operation. Never roll back databases or restart other roles.
stop_conditions: Live SHA or digest differs from the exact known production baseline.
Missing or mismatched Telegram credentials, hostname, webhook, local process inventory or expected role absence.
Any concurrent release, unknown polling consumer, failed Bot readiness, duplicate Bot, missing immutable image, missing protected environment approval, or partial Apply.
Any operation would restart Core API/Worker, Mini App, Eros, touch secrets or change schema.
